commits.message: fix(facts): a recorded draw state the store could not have held is refused; a replayed draw whose depths held moves nothing (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.gs4)

fix(facts): a recording replays a session's picks and open menus: each draw carries the state it read (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.gs4)

A recording carried the session's documents and requests but not what its
clicks left, so a replay drew every pick absent, every menu closed, both
histories empty and no closing flash.

Each draw line now carries the session's draw state: the store's values and
revision for the session, the settings history's and back history's depths,
and when its menus' idle period began. The revision crosses as itself because
frame memory keeps the last frame only while it holds; the idle instant is the
one the draw was handed, which the daemon's draw and the seam rig both read
through one MenuIdle method that hands, draws and observes. The replay
restores each draw's state before drawing it. The recording format is v3.

fix(links): a drawn link whose value does not decode reads as its refusal, the load error names the action as the remedy, and the socket import rule covers the renamed path (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.eul)

drawnClickOf promised the daemon's refusal for every drawn link, but a
malformed escape in a parsed link still threw from the decode; it now
returns the refusal the daemon gives that click. The load error for an
old-grammar literal says to bind an action, whose link names the
renderer that draws it. The eslint owner list for deriving a socket
still named the old function, so the renamed one was unrestricted. The
clicks design doc and the UI elements doc say links have one form.

fix(links): a drawn link the parse refuses reaches the daemon from the site and the harness, and a printf format's head ends at its first verb (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.eul)

A drawn link reads as one typed value, its effects or the parse's
refusal. The site and the drive-bar harness send a refused link to the
daemon, which refuses it with the reason, where they threw before;
effectsOf keeps throwing for tests that read the renderer's own links,
and the throwing click reader moves into the test helper that alone
used it.

A literal like "cc-candybar://%s/copy/%s" may have its address filled
in at the draw, so the load check reads its head up to the first `%`.
The wire module spells the scheme prefix and the address opener once.

fix(links): a template literal is refused at load only when no completion of it can name a renderer, quoted as written; a drawn link the daemon refuses reads as its refusal (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.eul)

The load check read each literal as a whole link, with a `/` appended,
so a literal that is only a link's head (`"cc-candybar://to/main"` joined
to a computed tail, `"cc-candybar://"` in a hasPrefix) failed to load, and
a bare literal was named the direct verb form and quoted with a slash the
author never wrote. A literal is now refused when it opens neither the
address nor a start of it, and the error quotes it as written.

describeLink names a refused drawn link's refusal instead of throwing, so
a config that computes an old-grammar link at the draw no longer fails the
dev viewers' whole frame.

feat(links)!: one link grammar: a link that names no renderer is refused naming its form, at the click, in the URL handler and at load (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.eul)

The parse reads cc-candybar://to/<name>/<verb>/<tail> alone; a direct
cc-candybar://<verb>/… or a bare cc-candybar://<value> is refused, with a
problem naming the form, and `to` is no longer nullable, so the daemon's
link judgement loses its null-address exception. The URL handler refuses
both forms through its notification, with fixed text. A template literal
in either form is a load error from the same parse; the retired-verb table
it made dead is deleted.

Every producer builds its link through one addressed-link builder: the
dispatch minter, the tmux status binding (recognised by its click verb, so
a binding from a build before names is still adopted), the doctor probe
(now probing a named home through the socket its name selects) and the
click bench. The install test URL, itself a bare copy link, is removed.

fix(facts): a recording replays each frame from what its answer drew, in the file's order, with the recorded home (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.rat) (#636)

* fix(facts): a recording replays each frame from what its answer drew, in the file's order, with the recorded home (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.rat)

A live answer is drawn after its request's wait, from the view that request
holds. The recording now writes a draw line when the answer is drawn, after
the document and the declaration that draw read (each restated when it is
not the last the recording wrote), and only to the recordings that saw the
request arrive. The replay walks the file's lines in order: the recording
arm serves the last document reached and keeps no clock. The header carries
the home the payloads were composed against.

* fix(facts): a play draws each answer at the instant its arm says the request arrived; the recording's format is facts v2 (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.rat)

The live demo drew at start + i×450ms while each settle spent real time
before the next sleep, so its clock fell behind the machine's frame by
frame. An arm now brings the clock to a request and says the instant it
arrived at: the live arm sleeps until the offset and reads its clock, as
the daemon reads an arrival; a held clock gives the recorded instant.

The recording's lines changed (a header home, draw and declared lines),
and the facts protocol version is what guards a recording, so it is 2:
a 1.199 recording is refused by its version, not by a missing field.

The header's home is the turn's, the one the payload was composed
against, and that home is a string at every caller. The parser's instant
reader is parseInstant, beside the parser's other parse functions.

* fix(facts): a recording has its own format version; a record counts its answers; one conversion of an instant back to ms (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.rat)

A recording's request, declared and draw lines are the renderer's request
path, not the facts protocol, so the file's header names its own format
(v2, refusing the shipped v1 by version) and the documents in it keep the
facts version each one's parse already refuses. Tying both to one number
would move Gather's versioned address for a renderer-only change.

What a finished recording reports is the answers it drew, the frames a
replay draws, and the record verb prints them as answers.

An instant's clock milliseconds are rounded back in one place: a Date
truncates, and an instant read off a millisecond clock can land a hair
below its reading.

## [1.200.0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.199.2...v1.200.0) (2026-11-06)

### Features

* **links:** a click reaches the renderer that drew it, by name (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.7q7) ([#632](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/632)) ([b38ab23](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/b38ab233e3dc44e6704d7461d5a952da81f5678d))

### Bug Fixes

* **just:** deploy builds the URL handler app on macOS, so install from a checkout finds it ([#635](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/635)) ([21b794e](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/21b794ed4cc04858233f9002c26af82023fcf86a))
fix(disk): the fake walks a new entry's parent, makes a `..` folder, refuses a move into itself and forgets a failed watch; path derivation takes a Filesystem (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)
fix(disk): the fake moves, removes, writes through links and resolves `..` as the kernel does; repo-configs is made on the tree that watches it; the real disk is owned (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)

feat(disk): files and their watch events go through one filesystem port, first used by the watcher registry and the binary watch (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)

A Filesystem port (src/disk/) with one adapter over fs, an in-memory fake whose writes emit the events a watch would on the clock, and one contract both pass. The watcher registry, its delivery owner, plugin storage, folder identity, the link walk and the binary watch read the disk through it; IdentityRead and BundleStat are gone. A lint rule bans fs outside the adapter, with an allowlist of the files still to move.
refactor(apply): a synchronous click needs no in-flight bracket on the idle clock; journaled refuses an async handler (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)
fix(apply): a probe link is refused by no client's leaving; the doctor stamps the hints it reads; the click error keeps its record's shape (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)
fix(apply): each click failure is its own held message; a fault's stack reaches the log; no gather starts after close (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

feat(apply): no turn awaits a launch; a doctor step is an effect, and a held click error accumulates (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

A turn is a synchronous call: its body cannot be async (Synchronous<T>), a
render request never waits behind another session's probes, and no draw can
read a click half landed. A doctor step describes an effect; the performer
gathers after the click's turn through a recording view, and the landing
checks the gather's read set and config in the turn that writes the report.
Lands yth: a click error held while the last is live joins it.
